title: Will Y NDE 21434
content: I am a big softy person and I love everybody. I had a pregnant wife for the second time but tried to solve my lover's problems first. The result was two loves and a confused brain’s decision to wrap it around a concrete lamppost at a hundred miles per hour. I was successful. I looked at myself lying there from the outside of the crumpled car. A voice standing beside me was saying, ‘Well, it's your choice to do you want. You can follow the light or continue on earth and face the music.’ I replied that I would face the music. On that answer, I awoke outside and facing the car crumpled up fifty feet away from the lamppost. At that same moment, a council lamp repair vehicle with two guys in it appeared from nowhere. I asked them for a lift home, which was twelve miles away. From there my wife took me to hospital. My injuries were a fractured skull, broken nose, cracked pelvis, broken ribs, broken foot, and a broken arm, (which was done when I put a forearm smash into the door to get out).

elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes Eyes looking towards the lifeless body.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes As it happened to me, I was like a bystander watching the event.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes He gave me the choice to go to the light and throw in the towel or try again and face the music.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes To my left, over my shoulder, was a bright piercing light. Also to my left was the voice that was talking to me.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe The choice of accepting or refusing.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will The choice to follow the light or face the music.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I feel the world’s troubles and people’s remorse. I flood tears at every sad event. People’s pain and sadness fills me with tears.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Knowing there is life after death.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes I got pissed again five years later and still did not manage to go to the light! I got back to a hospital three hundred fifty miles from the event covered in blood with only a fractured skull. And again the car was a write-off.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: To all you out there: learn from it. Use my experience to better yourself and not as I did to ignore it.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: Yes, ask for the truth. I am happy to fill in the twenty-five years since my experience to let you know how life dealt the cards after that.
